description: Source code for Bluetooth HCI UART asynchronous communication in Zephyr OS, handling UART transmission, reception, and HCI packet processing.

methods.name: uart_c2h_tx
methods.description: Sends data over UART from host to controller, blocking until complete.

methods.name: hci_payload_size
methods.description: Calculates payload size based on H4 packet type and header.

methods.name: hci_hdr_size
methods.description: Returns size of HCI header based on packet type.

methods.name: uart_h2c_rx
methods.description: Receives data over UART from controller to host, blocking until data is received or error occurs.

methods.name: send_hw_error
methods.description: Injects a hardware error event into the HCI stream.

methods.name: recover_sync_by_reset_pattern
methods.description: Resynchronizes HCI stream by detecting reset pattern.

methods.name: h2c_h4_transport
methods.description: Handles H4 transport protocol for outgoing HCI packets.

methods.name: h2c_thread_entry
methods.description: Main loop for transmitting HCI packets from host to controller.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: UART event callback handling UART events for RX and TX completion.

methods.name: hci_uart_init
methods.description: Initializes UART for HCI communication, sets callback, and checks device readiness.

methods.name: c2h_thread_entry
methods.description: Main loop for receiving HCI packets from controller to host.

methods.name: hci_uart_main
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize HCI UART communication and start threads.
